    p.p_partkey,
    p.p_name,
    SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_qty

    lineitem l
JOIN
    part p ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey
WHERE
    l.l_shipdate >= '1996-01-01'
    AND l.l_shipdate < '1997-01-01'
GROUP BY
    p.p_partkey,
    p.p_name
ORDER BY
    total_qty DESC,
    p.p_partkey ASC

SELECT
            s.s_name,
            SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue
        FROM
            lineitem l
        JOIN
            supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
        WHERE
            l.l_shipdate >= '1997-01-01'
            AND l.l_shipdate < '1998-01-01'
        GROUP BY
            s.s_suppkey
        HAVING
            SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 1.2 * (
                SELECT AVG(revenue)
                FROM (
                    SELECT
                        s2.s_suppkey,
                        SUM(l2.l_extendedprice * (1 - l2.l_discount)) AS revenue
                    FROM
                        lineitem l2
                    JOIN
                        supplier s2 ON l2.l_suppkey = s2.s_suppkey
                    WHERE
                        l2.l_shipdate >= '1997-01-01'
                        AND l2.l_shipdate < '1998-01-01'
                    GROUP BY
                        s2.s_suppkey
                ) AS subq
            )
        ORDER BY
            revenue DESC

WITH revenue_data AS (
  SELECT
    YEAR(o_orderdate) AS o_year,
    SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS revenue
  FROM orders o
  JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey
  WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1992-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1998-01-01'
  GROUP BY YEAR(o_orderdate)
)
SELECT
  o_year,
  revenue,
  100 * (revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY o_year)) / LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY o_year) AS pct_change
FROM revenue_data

SELECT
      SUBSTRING(p.p_type, 1, 1) AS family,
      SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue,
      SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * l.l_quantity) AS cost,
      ((SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) - SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * l.l_quantity)) / SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount))) AS margin
    FROM
      lineitem l
    JOIN
      partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey
    JOIN
      part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey
    WHERE
      l.l_shipdate >= '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < '1998-01-01'
    GROUP BY
      SUBSTRING(p.p_type, 1, 1)
    ORDER BY
      margin DESC

SELECT
            r.r_name,
            COUNT(*) AS order_count,
            SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_price
        FROM
            orders o
        JOIN
            customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
        JOIN
            lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey
        JOIN
            supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
        JOIN
            nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey AND s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
        JOIN
            region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey
        WHERE
            c.c_nationkey = s.s_nationkey
        GROUP BY
            r.r_name
        ORDER BY
            r.r_name

    c.n_name AS cust_region,
    ns.n_name AS supp_region,
    l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount) AS revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey
JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
JOIN nation ns ON s.s_nationkey = ns.n_nationkey
WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1997-01-01'
GROUP BY c.n_name, ns.n_name
ORDER BY c.n_name, ns.n_name
